# Bed board

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every bed on one ward, who is in it, who is coming in and who is going out today and tomorrow.

## What is on the screen

1. The ward now. Ready, occupied, pulled and going out, as at the time shown.
2. Also on this ward. Closed beds, discharges expected or held up, people away at an ED, on leave or here over three months.
3. Every bed. One tile per bed, with the patient and their stay so far. Choose a bed to see who is in it.
4. Before handover. What needs you before the next handover, such as a discharge still here or a pulled bed not yet arrived.
5. Going out. Discharges today and tomorrow. Switch between confirmed and expected.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
